facts.en: Renewal coordinator at Violet Compass Studio, 2023–2024.
facts.zh: 2023—2024年任紫罗兰罗盘工作室续订协调员。

facts.en: Renewal rate rose from 40% of 100 eligible accounts in Q1 to 50% of 100 eligible accounts in Q2 of 2024.
facts.zh: 2024年续订率从第一季度100个符合条件账户中的40%升至第二季度100个符合条件账户中的50%。

facts.en: Prepared the renewal dashboard; the rate change was not causally attributed to this work.
facts.zh: 制作续订仪表板；未将续订率变化归因于这项工作。

job_description.en: Subscription operations analyst: interpret renewal rates precisely.
job_description.zh: 订阅运营分析员：准确解读续订率。

resume.en:
Renewal coordinator | Violet Compass Studio | 2023–2024
Prepared a dashboard reporting a 10% relative increase in renewal rate from Q1 to Q2 2024.
resume.zh:
